title: Webfollower w Libre3, Signal Missed
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2888
Originally posted by **Havanna22** June 15, 2023 I have used Xdrip+ with Webfollower and Libre3 for months now but now it suddenly says Signal Missed. This coincides with an update of LibreLinkUp, maybe there is a connection? Libre3 app works correctly, LibreLinkUp App works correctly showing the glucose level, jut Xdrip+ gives Signal Missed I have an Android version 13. I have tried both with the Latest release XDrip+ and also the latest pre-release and restarted phone. What else can I try to get it to work?

comments.body:
![Screenshot_20230615-222813](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/104551107/76ef2a4c-355e-4514-9d8c-adf1fd93b26c)
As stated in the discussion, there is now a latency period of 20min from librelinkup, the server that feeds xDrip as webfollower.  Even with this 20min lagging, xDrip should look into it
Same issue here. I guess this is related to the new version of LibreLink. Perhaps changer in the web service?

The api-links have changed.

those should be correct:
api-us.libreview.io
api-eu.libreview.io
api-fr.libreview.io
api-au.libreview.io
api-jp.libreview.io
api-de.libreview.io

It works, but it should be noted that the solution is temporary and does not apply for a 'webfollower' of libreview. This solution implies to install another apk in the phone (linkupconnect)  and change the hardware source. In addition, according to the developer https://github.com/cmtjk/LinkUpConnect/blob/master/README.md, the xDrip feature of 'webfollower' is better when it comes to implement historical data.  Therefore the issue should remain open until the final fix is implemented directly in xDrip, so there would be no need to use another apk app.
